147977.overview:
Hot Line: Sporty Time Edition is a rare handheld electronic LCD game released by VTech in 1982 as part of their Sporty Time & Fun series.

In this retro classic, you take on the role of an office clerk who must frantically answer ringing telephones.

155822.overview: Hippo Teeth is a portable electronic game released by VTech under the Time & Fun brand in 1982. Apparently, this device was created in the likeness of the then popular series of portable electronic games Game & Watch from Nintendo.

156500.overview: Hippo Teeth is a pocket LCD game in VTech's Sporty Time & Fun series. The player protects a hippopotamus's teeth by moving a small figure and washing away attacking cavities with a hose. The watch-shaped unit also includes clock and alarm functions.

162008.overview: In this game, the player has to run across from the exit of one building and into the entrance of another while avoiding the various hardware tools that fall from the sky. Getting hit on the head by the rain of tools will issue the player a miss. The player scores by crossing the screen and waiting for five tools to drop.

190405.overview:
Home Alone 2: Lost in New York follows Kevin McCallister as he once again finds himself separated from his family during the holidays. Stranded in New York City, Kevin must evade the bumbling burglars Harry and Marv, known as the “Wet Bandits,” while using his clever traps and quick thinking to stay out of their reach.

The handheld game presents a side-view of Kevin navigating the interior of a New York hotel. The player moves Kevin left or right using two directional buttons while pressing an action button to trigger defensive moves such as throwing objects or jumping between safe zones. Enemies—depicting Harry and Marv—appear from different positions on the screen, advancing toward Kevin along fixed LCD segments. Successfully dodging or stunning the burglars awards points, while being caught costs a life.

As play continues, enemy speed and attack frequency increase, demanding faster reactions. The game cycles through several short stages represented by different screen segments, each symbolizing a location from the film—hotel halls, rooftops, or the streets below. Simple beeps and buzzes punctuate hits and misses, and the game ends when Kevin loses all lives or reaches the score threshold that triggers a reset to the first level.

190406.overview: Hook is a handheld LCD electronic video game developed by Tiger Electronics.

190485.overview:
Coleco Head to Head Electronic Baseball (Model 2180) is a vintage handheld electronic game released by Coleco Industries, Inc. in 1980. It became an iconic staple of retro 1980s gaming.

The game was highly unique for its time because it featured a dual-sided layout allowing two players to face off simultaneously. One player operates the pitching controls on one side, while the opponent sits opposite to manage the batting and running buttons.

200085.overview:
Released by Mattel Electronics in 1978, Mattel Electronic Hockey (Model 2946) is a landmark handheld electronic game that used red LED blips to simulate an ice hockey rink. Following the massive success of their 1977 Football game, Hockey introduced true 1- or 2-player action and multi-directional movement to the portable sports gaming craze of the late 1970s.

The object of the game is to outscore your opponent before the 3-period clock runs out.

476296.overview:
Race your motorcycle as fast as possible through 4 exciting and challenging scenes. The faster you drive, the more points you gain. So when you reach 120 MPH go ahead ... shift into "Hi-Gear" and give it all you've got!

But being a daredevil has its risks! Avoid crashing into the turn at every curve or into another motorcycle as it will cost you the precious minutes you will desperately need to complete each scene in the specific time allotted. If you do not finish in the required time you will be disqualified and lose the game. So watch out! Each scene becomes progressively more difficult, so don't lose your cool as you gain more speed!

Race as fast as possible through 4 exciting and challenging scenes.

Accelerate, shift to high gear and pass as many competitors as possible for more points.

You must complete each scene in the required time allotted or you will be disqualified and lose the game.

Avoid crashing into the curve or into another competitor as you will lose time. Drive as fast as possible to gain bonus points and beat your best score!

482392.overview: Hockey is an Elektronika LCD game in which a goalkeeper must stop pucks arriving from four corners of the rink. Use the four direction buttons to move the goalie into position before each shot reaches the goal. The action becomes faster as the score increases. Its catching mechanics adapt Nintendo’s egg-catching Game & Watch design to an ice-hockey setting.
